Name: The Impossible Bundle
Author: Mossy333
Description:
[u][b]About[/b][/u]
The Impossible bundle adds a few new bundles including one that is impossible to complete. This mod is a bit of useless fun.

[u][b]Bundles
[/b][/u]Trash bundle
Tree bundle
Chicken bundle
Dawf scroll bundle
"Edited bundle" (the final bundle)
Geode bundle (that is impossible to complete.)

[u][b]Install
[/b][/u]To install replace the Bundles.xnb in the "Stardew Valley\Content\Data" folder. (I recommend making a copy of either bundles.xnb or the whole content folder)
